method: Final 400 fixed-loadout battles after an initial 400-fight diagnostic batch stored separately. The final focus layout was manually improved so both weapon supports reach both weapons. Fresh independent combat seeds; 4 opponents × 100, 50 on each side per opponent. Same 70-gold equipment budget, including two traveler bags; all placements validated. Post-fusion items are counted at their ingredient prices. No stat changes. This is a matchup benchmark, not campaign win rate or proof of the globally optimal build. Healing totals are observations, not an ablation of the item effect.
